headline: Ryman Healthcare Half-Year Loss Widens 57% to $71.2M on Property Devaluations
summary: Ryman Healthcare reported a 57% increase in its half-year net loss to $71.2 million, driven by property devaluations and higher development costs.
why: Retirement village operators are sensitive to residential property valuations and construction cost inflation.

impacts.name: Ryman Healthcare
impacts.why: Higher net losses and property write-downs directly impair financial statements.
